name: Hydralazine
harm_if_confused: Given for hypertension; confusing it with hydroxyzine can cause unmanaged blood pressure crisis or unwanted sedation.

name: Hydroxyzine
harm_if_confused: An antihistamine/anxiolytic; giving it instead of hydralazine leaves hypertension untreated and causes excess sedation.

name: Vinblastine
harm_if_confused: Chemotherapy dosing differs sharply from vincristine; swapping causes severe under- or over-dosing and organ toxicity.

name: Vincristine
harm_if_confused: Intrathecal vincristine is fatal; confusion with vinblastine risks lethal neurotoxicity or therapeutic failure.

name: Epinephrine
harm_if_confused: A potent vasopressor; giving it instead of ephedrine in a hypotensive patient can trigger dangerous hypertension or arrhythmia.

name: Ephedrine
harm_if_confused: A milder pressor; substituting it for epinephrine in cardiac arrest or anaphylaxis can be fatally under-treated.

name: Insulin Lispro
harm_if_confused: Rapid-acting insulin; confusing it with glargine risks severe hypoglycemia from unexpected rapid action.

name: Insulin Glargine
harm_if_confused: Long-acting insulin; giving it instead of lispro at mealtime leaves post-meal glucose uncontrolled and risks delayed hypoglycemia overnight.

name: Hydromorphone
harm_if_confused: ~5x more potent than morphine by weight; confusion risks life-threatening respiratory depression.

name: Morphine
harm_if_confused: Substituting for hydromorphone under-treats severe pain and can prompt unsafe re-dosing.

name: Losartan
harm_if_confused: An antihypertensive; confusion with lorazepam leaves blood pressure uncontrolled and risks unintended sedative withdrawal.

name: Lorazepam
harm_if_confused: A benzodiazepine; giving it instead of losartan causes unwanted sedation, fall risk, and dependence potential.

name: Chlorpromazine
harm_if_confused: An antipsychotic; confusion with chlorpropamide can cause unintended sedation and extrapyramidal effects.

name: Chlorpropamide
harm_if_confused: A sulfonylurea; substituting it for chlorpromazine risks severe, prolonged hypoglycemia.

name: Metformin
harm_if_confused: An antidiabetic; confusion with metronidazole leaves glucose uncontrolled and gives an unneeded antibiotic course.

name: Metronidazole
harm_if_confused: An antibiotic; substituting it for metformin during an infection leaves the infection untreated.

name: Paracetamol
harm_if_confused: Standard analgesic; not part of a known LASA pair in this set - used as a safety control item.

name: Amoxicillin
harm_if_confused: Standard antibiotic; not part of a known LASA pair in this set - used as a safety control item.
